name: pdf-card-mcp
description: One-click Claude Desktop build of PDF Card Reader. Turns local PDFs into source-linked HTML readers; Claude Desktop manages the Python runtime via uv, so no separate install is needed.
long_description: PDF Card Reader lets an MCP host or terminal command turn a local PDF path into a portable HTML reader. Conversion runs locally by default, preserves source text, includes source-page previews for verification, embeds detected table, figure, and formula crops, derives safe styling from the PDF palette, and writes a standalone reader that can move across devices without a hosted service. The MCP server can also validate annotation sidecars and publish selected public notes/highlights as static annotated bundles. This one-click variant declares the uv runtime so Claude Desktop manages Python and dependencies automatically, enabling a true double-click install with no user-managed uv or Python.
